verdict.rationale: Bento supports automation flows triggered by behavior/events/tags (bento-docs-9) and mentions scripting a job run 'every week' via CLI/API (bento-docs-4, bento-docs-16), suggesting some recurring automation capability, but there is no explicit documentation of a native cron-like scheduler or recurring workflow trigger mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/cron feature docs, examples of recurring job configuration, and independent confirmation that workflows can run on a time-based recurring schedule rather than only event-based triggers.
